Committing/releasing the core's 40 uncommitted WIP paths is a release act requiring explicit current-conversation approval; it is not a Wave worker action.

The materializer correctly refuses while a live controller holds the lock (prior dispatch: EXIT=3, 'live controller: ac-wave-opencode-parallel.lock pid=51592').
